Bugs, coming at us from everywhere! It's like they were waiting for us!
Problems, Director? We just cleared out another Bug hive, and now all I'm hearing on the radio is your people calling for help.
For every action, there's a reaction. These hive purges must have provoked the Arachnids, and now they've overrun several facilities.
So why don't you just call in your new Mobile Infantry buddies?
I can't bring in any reinforcements while this ash storm is happening.
So you're stuck with us, huh? Okay, we'll clear those areas and get your people out of there....but it's going to cost you extra.
*sigh* Of course.
The facility’s ahead of you. You need to clear it of Arachnid infestation.
On it.
And you need to move faster. We're tracking another approaching ash storm.
Just what we need...
There it is! The processing plant!
Gunfire from it! Some of our people are still holding out there!
Come on! Let's help them out!

column2: Patel, you there? Storm's over, the skies are clear, and you owe us a whole bunch of bonus payments.
Understood. I'm sending Mobile Infantry reinforcements to your position now.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: DEFEND PROCESSING PLANT/TRIGGERS/ATTACK WAVES TIMELINES/WAVE 2 TIMELINE ==============

column2: Let's show these M.I. new arrivals how we kill Bugs in the private sector!
You can stand down now, Fraser. I'm sending Captain Zhao and further Mobile Infantry forces to take over from you and your people.
The dropships will bring you back to the station.
You serious? Pack up and let the Feds take over, when the battle isn't done yet?
The Mobile Infantry are a highly skilled military force--
--yeah, and they don't cost you anything. Unlike us.
I've made my decision. Return to the station...
...and need I remind you of the clause in your contract about the penalty for disobeying company directives being the forfeiture of all bonuses?

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: DEFEND PROCESSING PLANT/TRIGGERS/ATTACK WAVES TIMELINES/MERCENARY EVAC ==============

column2: The mercenaries started this Bug battle, but we'll show them how to finish it.
Get ready to repulse the Arachnid assault!
Processing plant secured, ma'am. The Bug infestation here has been eradicated.
Excellent work, captain. I knew it was the right decision to bring you and your people to help us on Gehenna.
Hold your fire! We're friendlies!
Okay, let's turn this place into a fortress. Bugs are gonna be on us any moment!
Remember, we're on our own here, until that storm clears!
Movement! Something coming at us out of cover of the ash storm!
Ash storm's easing off. At least now we can see what's coming at us.
Good news. The ash storm is passing over. You're free to call in reinforcements.
Good, cos we're gonna need 'em!
Someone get on that biped! It's what we need to take on these Immolator Bugs!
Fraser - receiving reports of a large Arachnid horde west of your current locale.
Any update on reinforcements for us?
Dropships still can't fly through the ash storm. You're on your own.
Confirmed. Get ready - that Arachnid horde is heading straight for you.
You and your people are well paid, Fraser. This is where you earn it.
Yeah. Real comforting...
Watch out! Bugs coming at us from two directions!
We gotta keep moving! If we stop, they'll surround and swarm us!
Keep going through them! The processing plant's just ahead!
That ash storm will soon be on you. Call in any reinforcements you need now. After it hits, you'll be cut off again.
HephaeStar Corp not providing more help? That’s contract work for ya… no benefits.
The ash storm's almost on you. In moments, it'll be too severe to risk any more dropships!
That's it. We're cut off! Gotta hold out until the storm's passed!
Immolators! Shit! We are not being paid enough to go up against these things!
